name: io.github.mattoddie/emby-mcp
title: Emby
description: Search, tag and organise an Emby media library: films, series, collections and playlists

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Serve MCP over stdio (the image defaults to HTTP).

environmentVariables.name: EMBY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Emby server's address with the port, such as http://emby.lan:8096.

environmentVariables.name: EMBY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: An Emby API key, from the Emby dashboard under API Keys.

environmentVariables.name: EMBY_USER
environmentVariables.description: Optional Emby user whose watched state and favourites to use. Empty means the first administrator.

environmentVariables.name: EMBY_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Allow changes: tags, metadata, collections, playlists, watched state, refreshes. Off means read-only.

environmentVariables.name: EMBY_ALLOW_DELETES
environmentVariables.description: Also allow deleting collections and playlists (never media files). Needs EMBY_ALLOW_WRITES.

environmentVariables.name: EMBY_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated toolsets to expose fewer tools, e.g. library,metadata,collections. Empty means all but raw.

environmentVariables.name: EMBY_TLS_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: Optional SHA-256 fingerprint of a self-signed https certificate.

environmentVariables.name: EMBY_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Optional audit log of every change: stderr, or a file path inside the container.
